# S006 — cross-index incremental-information falsification
Registered before results. Mechanism: common information can reach correlated markets at different speeds. Primary precedents are cross-asset ETF/futures flow (OFR2019) and cross-autocorrelations/nonsynchronous sampling (Lo/MacKinlay1989). Neither establishes MES/MNQ leadership or tradability; this tests that extrapolation, not replicates those papers.
Sources https://www.financialresearch.gov/working-papers/2019/10/23/cross-asset-market-order-flow-liquidity-and-price-discovery/ and https://www.nber.org/papers/w2960 .
